paragraphs: We are SFL Corporation Ltd., a company incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on October 10, 2003, as a Bermuda exempted company under the Bermuda Companies Law of 1981 (Company No. EC-34296). We are engaged primarily in the ownership and operation of vessels and offshore related assets, and we are also involved in the charter, purchase and sale of assets. Our registered and principal executive offices are located at Par-la-Ville Place, 14 Par-la-Ville Road, Hamilton, HM 08, Bermuda, and our telephone number is (441) 295-9500. Our website is www.sflcorp.com. The SEC maintains an Internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC. The address of the SEC's internet site is www.sec.gov. None of the information contained on these websites is incorporated into or forms a part of this annual report.
We operate through subsidiaries and branches located in Bermuda, Canada, Cyprus, Liberia, Namibia, Norway, Singapore, the United Kingdom and the Marshall Islands.

We are an international ship owning and chartering company with a large and diverse asset base across the maritime, shipping and offshore asset classes and business sectors. As of December 31, 2025, our assets consist of 17 tankers, two dry bulk carriers, 21 container vessels, seven car carriers and two drilling rigs, as well as five dual-fuel 16,800 TEU container vessels under construction, expected to be delivered in 2028. We also hold an equity interest in an associated company that owns four leased-in container vessels.

Our primary objective is to continue to grow our business through accretive acquisitions across a diverse range of marine and offshore asset classes. In doing so, our strategy is to generate stable and increasing cash flows by chartering our assets primarily under medium to long-term bareboat or time charters.

We were formed in 2003 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Frontline, a major operator of large crude oil tankers. In 2004, Frontline distributed 25% of our common shares to its ordinary shareholders in a partial spin off, and our common shares commenced trading on the NYSE, under the ticker symbol "SFL" on June 14, 2004. Frontline subsequently made six further dividends of our shares to its shareholders, and its ownership in our Company is now less than one percent. Our assets at the time consisted of a fleet of Suezmax tankers, very large crude carriers or VLCCs, and oil/bulk/ore carriers.

Since 2004, we have diversified our asset base and now have eight asset types: crude oil tankers, oil product tankers, chemical tankers, container vessels, car carriers, dry bulk carriers, a jack-up drilling rig and an ultra-deepwater drilling rig. In addition, we have certain financial investments.
We entered into the following acquisitions, deliveries, capital investments and disposals in 2023, 2024, 2025 and until March 16, 2026:
Acquisitions, Deliveries and Capital Investments

During the year ended December 31, 2023, we invested $117.8 million for special periodic surveys, or SPS, ballast water treatment systems and other capital upgrades performed on the harsh environment semi-submersible drilling rig Hercules.

As of November 2023, we had paid total installments and related costs of $158.4 million in relation to two dual-fuel 7,000 CEU newbuilding car carriers designed to use LNG under construction. The vessels, Emden and Wolfsburg, were delivered in September and November 2023, respectively. On delivery, the vessels performed a voyage charter for an Asia based operator from Asia to Europe, and thereafter, the vessels started a 10-year time charter to Volkswagen Group.

As of March 2024, we had paid total installments and related costs of $170.2 million in relation to two dual-fuel 7,000 CEU newbuilding car carriers under construction. The vessels, Odin Highway and Thor Highway, were delivered between January and March 2024, respectively, and commenced a 10-year time charter to K Line.

Between June 2024 and October 2024, we acquired and took delivery of three newbuilding LR2 product tankers, SFL Tucana, SFL Taurus and SFL Tigris from entities related to our largest shareholder, Hemen, for a total cost of $234.9 million. Upon delivery, the vessels immediately commenced long-term charters to a third party.

In July 2024, we entered into agreements to build five LNG dual-fuel 16,800 TEU container vessels at an aggregate construction cost of $962.5 million. The vessels are expected to be delivered in 2028 and are scheduled to commence a minimum 10-year time charter to a leading liner company. As of December 2025, we paid yard installments of $144.4 million relating to the newbuilding container vessels under construction.

In August 2024, we took delivery of two LNG dual-fuel 33,000 dwt chemical tankers, SFL Bonaire and SFL Aruba, from an unrelated third party for a total purchase price of $113.6 million. Upon delivery, one of the vessels commenced trading in a pool with Stolt Tankers Chartering B.V., or Stolt Tankers, for a period of eight years and the second vessel commenced an eight-year time charter with Stolt Tankers.

headings: The seaborne transportation industry is cyclical and volatile, and this may lead to reductions in our charter hire rates, vessel values and results of operations.
Our business is affected by macroeconomic conditions, including rising inflation, high interest rates, market volatility, economic uncertainty and supply chain constraints.
We have provided parent company guarantees for certain of our subsidiaries' obligations, which could expose us to material liabilities.
Developments in safety and environmental requirements relating to the recycling of vessels may result in escalated and unexpected costs.
Climate change, greenhouse gas restrictions and a shift in consumer demand for oil may adversely impact our operations and markets.
Regulations relating to ballast water discharge may adversely affect our revenues and profitability.
Future exploration and drilling results are uncertain and involve substantial risks and costs.
New technologies may cause our current drilling methods to become obsolete, resulting in an adverse effect on our business.
Increased inspection procedures, tighter import and export controls and new security regulations could increase costs and cause disruption of our business.
paragraphs: Our assets are primarily engaged in transporting crude oil and oil products, dry bulk and containerized cargoes, freight of rolling cargo, and in offshore drilling and related activities. The risk factors summarized in the Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward Looking Statements and Summary of Risk Factors and detailed below, summarize certain risks that may materially affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. Unless otherwise indicated in this annual report on Form 20-F, all information concerning our business and our assets is as of March 16, 2026.
The principal risks that could adversely affect, or have adversely affected, our Company's business, operation results and financial conditions are categorized and detailed below.

Our assets operate within a variety of markets that are volatile and unpredictable. Several risk factors including but not limited to our global and local market presence will impact our widespread operations. We are exposed to regulatory, statutory, operational, technical, counterpart, environmental and political risks, and other developments and regulations applicable to us and our industry that may impact and or disrupt our business. Details of specific risks relating to our industry are described below.

Our Company is subject to a significant number of external and internal risks. We are an entity incorporated in Bermuda with operations in different jurisdictions, markets and industries and, with numerous employees, shareholders, customers and other stakeholders having varying interests, and this broad exposure subjects us to significant risks. We also engage in activities, operations and actions that could result in harm to our Company, and adversely affect our financial performance, position and our business. Details of specific risks relating to our Company are described below.

Our common shares are subject to a significant number of external and internal risks. The market price of our common shares has historically been unpredictable and volatile. As a holding company, we depend on the ability of our subsidiaries to distribute funds to satisfy our financial and other obligations. As we are a foreign corporation, our shareholders may not have the same rights as a shareholder in a U.S. corporation may have. In addition, our shareholders may not be able to bring suit against us or enforce a judgement obtained in the United States against us since our offices and the majority of our assets are located outside of the United States. Furthermore, sales of our common shares could cause the market price of our common shares to decline. Details of specific risks relating to our common shares are described below.

Some risks are static while other risks may change and will vary depending on global and corporate developments that may occur now or in the future. The risk factors below identify risks relating to our industry, Company and common shares. These risks may not cover all and future applicable risk factors applicable to us.

paragraphs: 我們是 SFL Corporation Ltd.，一家根據伯明翰法律於 2003 年 10 月 10 日註冊成立的公司，為 1981 年伯明翰公司法下註冊的豁免公司（公司編號 EC-34296）。我們主要從事船舶及離岸相關資產的所有權與營運，同時也參與資產的租賃、購買新增及出售。我們的註冊及主要營運辦公室位於伯明翰 Hamilton 的 Par-la-Ville Place, 14 Par-la-Ville Road, HM 08，電話號碼為 (441) 295-9500。我們的網站為 www.sflcorp.com。美國證券交易委員會（SEC）維護一個網際網路網站，該網站包含發行人提交的報告、股東通函及資訊聲明等資料。SEC 網站的網址為 www.sec.gov。這些網站上所載的資訊並未納入本年度報告之中。
我們透過設立於伯明翰、加拿大、塞浦路斯、利比亞、納米比亞、挪威、新加坡、英國及馬紹爾羣島的子公司及分支機構進行營運。
我們是一家國際船舶擁有及租賃公司，資產規模龐大且多元化，涵蓋海運、船舶及離岸資產類別與業務領域。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的資產包括 17 艘油輪、2 艘乾散貨船、21 艘貨櫃船、7 艘車輛運輸船及 2 艘鑽井平台，以及 5 艘雙燃料 16,800 TEU 貨櫃船正在建造中，預計於 2028 年交付。我們也持有與一家關聯公司共同投資的權益，該公司擁有 4 艘租賃貨櫃船。
我們的主要目標是透過在多樣化的海洋及離岸資產類別中進行有價值的收購，持續擴大業務規模。為達成此目標，我們的策略是透過中長期光租或定期租賃方式出租資產，以產生穩定且持續增長的現金流。

我們於 2003 年成立，為 Frontline 的全資子公司，Frontline 是一家主要經營大型原油油輪的公司。2004 年，Frontline 將我們的普通股 25% 分配給其普通股股東，作為部分分拆，我們的普通股於 2004 年 6 月 14 日在紐約證券交易所（NYSE）開始交易，股票代碼為 "SFL"。Frontline 隨後又對股東進行了六次進一步的股息分配，目前其在本公司所持股份已低於 1%。當時我們的資產包括一隊蘇伊士型油輪、超大型原油載重船（VLCC）及油/散貨/礦石運輸船。
自 2004 年起，我們已將資產組成多元化，目前共有八種資產類型：原油油輪、油品油輪、化學油輪、貨櫃船、車輛運輸船、乾散貨船、一座架式鑽井平台及一座超深水鑽井平台。此外，我們也擁有某些財務投資。
我們於 2023 年、2024 年、2025 年及至 2026 年 3 月 16 日前進行了以下收購、交付、資本投資及處置活動：
收購、交付及資本投資
於2023年12月31日結業年度，本公司投資117.8 百萬美元用於特殊週期性調查（Special Periodic Surveys, SPS）壓載水處理系統及其他資本性升級工程，這些工程係針對嚴苛環境半潛式鑽井平台赫丘利斯（Hercules）進行。

截至2023年11月，本公司已支付與兩艘雙燃料7,000 CEU新造船車載運輸船相關之總 installment 及相關費用共158.4 百萬美元，此兩艘船設計用於使用液化天然氣（LNG）。該兩艘船分別為埃姆登（Emden）與沃爾夫斯堡（Wolfsburg），於2023年9月及11月分別交付。交付後，該兩艘船執行了一趟由亞洲至歐洲之租賃航程，之後該兩艘船開始進行10年期之定期租賃，租賃對象為Volkswagen Group。
截至2024年3月，本公司已支付與兩艘雙燃料7,000 CEU新造船車載運輸船相關之總 installment 及相關費用共170.2 百萬美元，此兩艘船目前仍在建造中。該兩艘船分別為奧丁公路（Odin Highway）與索爾公路（Thor Highway），於2024年1月至3月間分別交付，並開始進行10年期之定期租賃，租賃對象為K Line。
於2024年6月至10月間，本公司自與最大股東Hemen有關聯之實體取得三艘新造船LR2產品油輪SFL Tucana、SFL Taurus及SFL Tigris，總成本為234.9 百萬美元。交付後，該三艘船立即開始與第三方簽訂長期租賃。
於2024年7月，本公司與建造五艘液化天然氣（LNG）雙燃料16,800 TEU貨櫃船，總建造成本為962.5 百萬美元。該五艘船預計於2028年交付，並預計開始進行至少10年期之定期租賃，租賃對象為一家領先的航運公司。截至2025年12月，本公司已支付與該新造船貨櫃船相關之船廠 installment 約144.4 百萬美元。
於2024年8月，本公司自無關第三方取得兩艘液化天然氣（LNG）雙燃料33,000 dwt化學油輪SFL Bonaire及SFL Aruba，總購入價格為113.6 百萬美元。交付後，其中一艘船開始與Stolt Tankers Chartering B.V.（或稱Stolt Tankers）共同經營池運八年的航運業務，另一艘船則開始與Stolt Tankers簽訂八年的定期租賃。

headings: 國際海上運輸業為週期性且波動性高的產業，這可能導致我們的租船費率、船舶價值及營運成果下降。
我們的業務受總體經濟條件影響，包括通貨膨脹上升、高利率、市場波動、經濟不確定性及供應鏈限制。
我們為某些子公司的義務提供了母公司擔保，這可能會使我們面臨重大負債。
安全與環境要求的發展，可能導致船舶回收相關成本增加且出現未預期的費用。
氣候變遷、溫室氣體限制及油品需求的轉變，可能對本公司營運與市場產生不利影響。
關於壓載水排放的規範，可能對本公司營收與獲利產生不利影響。
未來探勘與鑽井結果具有不確定性，並涉及重大風險與成本。
新興技術可能使本公司現有鑽井方法過時，進而對本公司業務產生不利影響。
增加的檢查程序、更嚴格的進出口管制及新的安全規範，可能提高成本並導致本公司業務中斷。
paragraphs: 本公司資產主要從事原油及石油製品、乾貨散裝貨物及集裝箱貨物、滾動貨物運輸，以及離岸鑽井及相關活動。風險因素總結於前瞻性陳述的警示聲明及風險因素摘要與詳細說明中，並於下文詳細說明，這些風險可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運結果產生重大影響。除非本年度報告書（Form 20-F）另有說明，否則有關本公司業務及資產之資訊均為2026年3月16日之資料。
可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況產生負面影響，或已產生負面影響的主要風險於下文分類並詳細說明。
本公司資產運作於多種市場，這些市場具有波動性與不可預測性。若干風險因素包括但不限於本公司在全球及地方市場的經營據點，將影響本公司廣泛的營運。本公司面臨法規、法律、營運、技術、交易對手、環境及政治風險，以及其他適用於本公司及產業的發展與法規，這些因素可能影響或幹擾本公司業務。與本公司產業相關的特定風險於下文詳細說明。
本公司面臨大量外部與內部風險。本公司為註冊於百慕達的公司，營運於不同司法管轄區、市場與產業，並擁有眾多員工、股東、客戶及其他利害關係人，其利益各異，因此本公司具有廣泛的風險敞口。本公司亦從事可能對本公司造成損害的活動、營運與行為，並可能對本公司財務表現、財務狀況及業務產生負面影響。與本公司相關的特定風險於下文詳細說明。
